scenarios.prompt: Create a workflow named portable-echo-workflow with no tool, agent, or nested workflow dependencies. It accepts a required message string and returns that same value in a message field using a mapping step.

Create a workflow named portable-greeting-workflow with no tool, agent, or nested workflow dependencies. It accepts a required name string and returns a message formatted as Hello, <name>! using a mapping template.

Create a workflow named portable-order-status-workflow with no tool, agent, or nested workflow dependencies. It accepts a required orderId string and returns the same orderId with a constant status of received using one mapping step.

Create a workflow named portable-profile-workflow with no tool, agent, or nested workflow dependencies. It accepts required name and age fields and returns an object containing those same fields using a mapping step.

Create a workflow named portable-tags-workflow with no tool, agent, or nested workflow dependencies. It accepts a required tags array of strings and returns that array in a tags field using a mapping step.

Create a workflow named portable-chained-mapping-workflow with no tool, agent, or nested workflow dependencies. It accepts a required value string, maps it into a normalizedValue field, then uses a second mapping step to return that prior step value in a result field.

Create a workflow named portable-receipt-workflow with no tool, agent, or nested workflow dependencies. It accepts required item and quantity fields and returns a summary string formatted as Ordered <quantity> x <item> using a mapping template.

Create a workflow named portable-defaults-workflow with no tool, agent, or nested workflow dependencies. It accepts an empty object and returns enabled true, retries 3, and mode safe using one mapping step with constant values.
